workarounds.symptom: [Serve] FastAPI based deployment doesn't respect ASGI scope state.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [serve] Copy the ASGI lifespan state into each request scope. Target files: python/ray/serve/_private/http_util.py, python/ray/serve/tests/test_fastapi.py, python/ray/serve/tests/unit/test_http_util.py. A FastAPI app or ASGI middleware that stores resources in its lifespan state can't read them from a request in Ray Serve. Under plain FastAPI plus uvicorn, each request's `scope["state"]` holds a shallow copy of the lifespan state, as the [ASGI lifespan state spec](https://asgi.readthedocs.io/en/latest/specs/lifespan.html#li... (Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/67844)

workarounds.symptom: [Serve] graceful_shutdown_wait_loop_s=0 busy-loops the drain and floods replica logs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [serve] Don't busy-loop the replica drain when graceful_shutdown_wait_loop_s=0. Target files: python/ray/serve/_private/constants.py, python/ray/serve/_private/replica.py, python/ray/serve/tests/unit/test_replica_quiesce.py. `graceful_shutdown_wait_loop_s` accepts 0, but then `_drain_ongoing_requests` loops on `asyncio.sleep(0)` and logs "Waiting for an additional 0.0s to shut down" on every pass. The replica's event loop uses a full core and the log gets thousands of lines per drain. With direct ingress, an idle replica al... (Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/67434)

workarounds.symptom: [Serve] Health checks replace live replicas on transient ActorUnavailableError
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Serve] Distinguish ActorUnavailableError from actor death in health checks. Target files: python/ray/serve/_private/deployment_state.py, python/ray/serve/tests/unit/test_deployment_state.py. This PR distinguishes temporary actor unavailability from actor death in Serve health checks and applies the existing consecutive-failure thresholds before replacement. (Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/65986)

workarounds.symptom: [Serve] With RAY_SERVE_LOG_TO_STDERR=0, print(..., file=f) in a replica writes the args tuple, which garbles every logged traceback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Serve] Unpack args in redirected_print's builtin-print fallback. Target files: python/ray/serve/_private/logging_utils.py, python/ray/serve/tests/test_logging.py. With `RAY_SERVE_LOG_TO_STDERR=0`, `configure_component_logger` replaces `builtins.print` with `redirected_print` in every replica. The fallback branch for file targets other than stdout/stderr passed the whole `objects` tuple to the builtin print, so `print("a", "b", file=f)` wrote `('a', 'b')`. `logging.Formatter.formatException` formats tracebacks through `prin... (Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/67785)

(Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/65923)

workarounds.symptom: [Data] `to_pandas()` returns another row's value or raises for null rows in tensor columns
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Data] Keep tensor columns with null rows mergeable across blocks.
